name: Agitan 260
description: Agitan 260 (CAS 255719-70-1 ), also supplied under the designation AGITAN P 803, is a silicone-free defoamer and wetting agent used across water-based industrial formulations. It controls foam build-up during production and application while improving substrate wetting, helping formulators maintain process efficiency and end-product quality. In architectural and industrial coatings, Agitan 260 suppresses foam generated during high-speed dispersion and application, preventing surface defects such as craters and pinholes. Adhesive and sealant manufacturers incorporate it to eliminate entrapped air during mixing and coating operations where foam causes bond inconsistencies in the final product. In industrial and institutional cleaning concentrates, it controls foam in spray and mechanical wash systems where excess lather reduces overall cleaning performance. Textile processing operations use it to manage foam in padding, dyeing, and finishing baths where foam interference disrupts liquor circulation and fabric treatment uniformity. Agitan 260 is supplied as a liquid, suitable for direct addition or dilution into water-based systems. It is available in standard industrial packaging including drums and IBCs. Bulk procurement is available for industrial users. Technical grade is the standard commercial specification for this product, ensuring consistent performance across various applications.
